text:
priya: heads-up - ap-northeast-1 GPU pool failing to join after morning firewall hardening. noticed warm pool dip and image pulls stuck. :warning:
ops-bot: ALERT node-join: 1761230000  9 nodes failing to bootstrap
dan: logs show ephemeral port exhaustion on the privatelink NAT when talking to keystore in another AZ. example:
```
2026-04-02T09:12:01Z kubelet: keystore handshake: tcp_connect: no buffer - connect: cannot assign requested address
2026-04-02T09:12:02Z runtime: bootstrap failed: KMS handshake error
```
marco: firewall rules were tightened to deny high-number ephemeral ranges for outbound. privatelink connection reuse relied on short-lived outbound ports -> stateful mapping blew up under parallel joins.
elena: autoscaler interplay: scaled to replace failing nodes -> new nodes also hit port exhaustion -> rapid churn and on-demand GPU spike. finance-bot: estimated spend delta +27% in the last 25m.
priya: quick mitigations: 1) open ephemeral range 32768-61000 to keystore privatelink cidr on control-plane subnets 2) bump conntrack & nat port allocation on NATs 3) set autoscaler cooldown to 15m and pause warm-pool replacements
dan: sg patch command: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0f1e2d3c --protocol tcp --port 32768-61000 --cidr 10.51.0.0/20`  applied as patch ep-open-1761230035
ops-bot: 1761230040: sg patch ep-open-1761230035 applied by dan. validating joins
marco: nodes recovering: 2 -> 9 in 2m. warming stable.
elena: we should also bake a local keystore cache into the bootstrap image and add a conntrack check to our rollout canary.
security-bot: Temporary allow logged as CHG-EPHEMERAL-176123. Exception auto-reverts in 45m. Please file postmortem for compliance.
priya: filing INFRA-4342 with timeline, commands, cost impact, and remediation items (baked cache, conntrack test, firewall rule template).
ops-bot: monitoring window open 45m. resolve if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
